name: Kakucs (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kakucs (a blue shield with a tree, a crescent, a heart, a bird and a sabre) between the name KAKUCS above and KÖZSÉG below, with the year 1784 either side, in yellow.
history: The municipal arms and the flag bearing them were adopted in 1993. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
